answer: In an attestation graph, trust can be estimated by length-bounded random walks from independently anchored identities, limiting endorsement diffusion. If a Sybil cluster has low conductance—a sparse cut to the honest graph—few walks cross into it, bounding the cluster’s reachable voting weight by its cut capacity rather than its internal echo. This requires resistant anchors and controlled edge weights; “tide” and “copper” are labels, not evidence.
